inputs.share_count_basis: 827.0m shares in issue less 71.6m held by the share-award-scheme trustee (no awards ever granted since the 2018 scheme adoption; FY2025 AR p.34 and note 13) = 755.4m, the basis of the company's own basic and diluted EPS. Held FLAT: no SBC since FY2022, no convertibles, no options outstanding. If the trust shares were ever awarded, per-share values fall 8.7%.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 AR consolidated statement of changes in equity: no share-based payment charge FY2022-FY2025 (last was RMB34k in FY2021); share award scheme has never granted an award (AR FY2025 p.34). SBC-zero filer.
inputs.fx_note: CNY->HKD 1.1749 from Yahoo CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-22T06:20Z; cross-checked via USDHKD 7.8447 / USDCNY 6.6737 = 1.1755 (0.05% tie) and 1/HKDCNY 0.8503 = 1.1760. All flows and the balance sheet are RMB; per-share values are computed in CNY and multiplied by 1.1749 into HKD. No dual listing exists for a parity check; the triangulation is the check. refresh_price.py moves the price but not this rate -- re-derive it on any later update.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-22T06:05:12Z (HKEX afternoon session, intraday regular trading; not after-hours)
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows: 10y CGB ~1.8% risk-free, China ERP ~6.5% at beta ~0.9 (=5.9%), plus ~1.3% for an HK-listed small-cap with a 66% controlling shareholder (BH Corporate Services trust, FY2025 AR p.25) -> cost of equity ~9.0%. Bank borrowings are RMB307m at 1.1% against RMB7.5bn cash, so WACC = cost of equity = 9.0%. Same 9% across all three scenarios: policy and governance risk are charged in the flows and the weights, not stacked into the rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: (A) Leases as debt. Lease liabilities (RMB4.8m current + RMB0.5m non-current at 30 Jun 2026) are inside total_debt; lease principal (RMB9.3m FY2025) is NOT deducted from the flows; lease_cost_pct_path is 0. Immaterial either way (<0.3% of revenue).
inputs.nci_treatment: None: profit attributable to owners equals profit for the year in every period (no non-controlling interests).
inputs.investment_income_treatment: Investment income (FY2025 RMB393.3m = bank/structured-deposit interest 216.4m + financial-product income 177.0m; H1-2026 RMB113.0m) is EXCLUDED from the EBITDA margin build, and its source asset -- the full RMB7,538m bank balance -- sits in the bridge at face. inputs.interest_income is 0 rather than 216.4 because under the company's HKFRS presentation 'Interest received' and financial-product redemptions sit in INVESTING activities and both are reversed out of OCF (FY2025 AR cash-flow statement lines 3036-3037, 3079-3080), so reported_fcf = OCF - capex is already ex-investment-income and a second deduction would double-strip. At 30 Jun 2026 the FVTPL financial products had been fully redeemed into cash (RMB376.6m at Dec-2025 -> nil), so nothing is left outside the cash line.
inputs.other_income_treatment: Enterprise development funds (Hebei local-government R&D support, booked in other income): FY2024 RMB174.1m, FY2025 RMB167.9m, H1-2025 156.3m, H1-2026 126.3m -- a recurring stream of ~5% of revenue for a decade. It IS cash (not reversed from OCF) and is kept inside the EBITDA margin path, fading in the base and bear cases because it is discretionary policy support.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (SKILL.md row 'operating company, non-US'), with the adaptations file applied for currency (CNY flows vs HKD quote), leases, excluded income / matching asset, and SBC-zero. Not a holdco, bank or REIT -- it is a single-segment TCM manufacturer whose balance sheet happens to be two-thirds cash. ANCHORS: price intraday 22 Oct 2026; balance sheet and share count from the 30 June 2026 interim; FY0 flows FY2025. Using the June-2026 balance sheet with FY2026 as year 1 overlaps H1-2026 owner FCF of RMB196m (~RMB0.26/share, ~HK$0.30) -- immaterial against RMB9.57/share of net cash and offset by the RMB325m H1-2026 dividend already paid out of that cash. OPERATING MARGIN HISTORY (EBIT ex other/investment income, before impairment, + D&A): FY2021 22.5%, FY2022 23.0%, FY2023 25.5%, FY2024 26.4%, FY2025 27.7%, H1-2026 34.7% (S&D costs -52% under VBP's lower distribution/promotion fees); adding enterprise development funds gives 31.0% FY2024, 32.3% FY2025, 45.6% H1-2026. FY2025 reported FCF (974m) was flattered by ~RMB400-600m of working-capital release (receivables run-off as sales fell); the component build does not carry that forward -- year-1 modelled owner FCF is ~RMB500m. BASE REVENUE: FY2025 RMB3,135m; H1-2026 was -28.5%, H2-2025 comps are easier (-12% YoY), so FY2026 is modelled -26%. CASH TAX 25%: FY2025 effective 25.2% / cash 22.7% of PBT; concessionary 15% HNTE rates and the 200% R&D super-deduction are offset by 5% PRC-to-HK dividend withholding tax; bear 27%, bull 23%. BUYBACKS: none since FY2020 (RMB36m); the flat count is a convention the company does not pay for -- but there is no SBC to fund either. Distributions are dividends: RMB1.23/share declared for 2026 (RMB929m, ~20% yield on the current price).

equity_bridge.item: 5% PRC withholding tax on repatriating net cash to the HK holding companies, net of the RMB48.0m deferred-tax liability already provisioned for undistributed profits (30 Jun 2026 interim, non-current liabilities)
equity_bridge.note: 0.05 x 7,226.1 = 361.3 less 48.0 provisioned. FY2025 tax note 10: immediate HK holding companies qualify for the 5% treaty rate. Applied to the whole balance for conservatism although part is held in HKD/AUD at the parent.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case FY2026-FY2030 average revenue growth (-26, -10, -3, 0, +1). Every backward-looking CAGR is rejected: the FY2020 base year was the COVID trough and FY2023 the post-COVID respiratory peak (RMB4,517m), so the 3yr/5yr figures bracket a cycle that VBP has since reset.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 6.8% diverges >30% from revenue 5yr 3.4% (and 3yr -7.4%) and from EPS 5yr 26.4%: equity growth is retained investment income on the cash pile, EPS growth is the FY2020 COVID-trough base plus rising investment income, neither is operating growth. FCF CAGRs use the owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC; interest is already in investing, so it is excluded in every year); SBC is zero across the whole history so owner and reported CAGRs coincide.
historical_growth.notes: Revenue: FY2020 2,655.7 -> FY2022 3,950.6 -> FY2023 peak 4,516.5 -> FY2025 3,135.4 -> H1-2026 1,181.1 (-28.5% YoY). The decline is broad-based: FY2025 injections -19.8%, formula granules -14.4%, granules -19.4%, soft capsules -12.0%; H1-2026 injections -43.4%, formula granules -31.1%, oral products -20.8%.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 -26% (H1 -28.5%, easier H2 comps); FY2027 -10% as Hebei formula-granule VBP prices annualise and injections keep shrinking, partly offset by Sailuotong/JC Capsule launches; trough FY2028-29; mature TCM industry growth of 1.5% thereafter, in line with the 2026-2030 TCM plan but below nominal GDP.
base.margin_rationale: Operating EBITDA incl. enterprise development funds was 32.3% in FY2025 and 45.6% in H1-2026 after S&D fell 52%. Base takes 36% for FY2026 (H2 seasonally weaker, part of the S&D cut reverses), fading to 28% as gross margin compresses under further VBP rounds, R&D rises toward 5-6% of sales, and the subsidy halves.
base.da_capex_rationale: D&A is ~RMB150m and fixed in money terms, so on a ~RMB2.2bn revenue base it is 7%; capex RMB140-200m (FY2023-25) -> 6.5%, slightly above D&A for the classic-prescription product build-out.
base.wc_rationale: Net working capital is slightly negative (accruals-heavy other payables RMB1.36bn vs receivables + inventory RMB1.40bn); FY2025 released ~RMB500m as receivables ran off, H1-2026 consumed cash as accruals unwound. Sign is indeterminate over the horizon, so 0% capture in base and bull.
base.terminal_rationale: Cap at 12x FCF (method: 12-15x for structurally slower businesses) -- a mature, policy-pressured TCM manufacturer; Gordon at 9%/1.5% would be 13.5x.

bull.narrative: Destocking ends in FY2026, the 2026 Essential Drugs List expansion (proprietary TCM 268->318) and both Phase-III-complete exclusive drugs launching in 2027 return the oral franchise to mid-single-digit growth from FY2028; formula-granule consolidation under the 2025 production provisions lets Shineway hold price; S&D savings under VBP are structural so margins settle at 32%; HNTE 15% rates keep the cash tax at 23%.

bear.narrative: The NMPA re-evaluation restricts TCM injections (32% of FY2025 sales) and further provincial VBP alliances cut formula-granule prices again; revenue halves from FY2025 by FY2029 and never recovers; the enterprise development funds are withdrawn, gross margin slides below 65% and operating deleverage takes EBITDA to 20%; accruals unwind consumes cash (5% capture on the decline); zero terminal growth at a 10x cap. No scenario hits the zero TV floor.

scenario_narratives.base: Policy reset, then a flat-to-low-growth TCM business sitting on a cash pile. The axes are (1) how far VBP/NHSA cost control cuts injection and formula-granule prices before the reset is complete, (2) whether the S&D cost base that fell 52% in H1-2026 stays down, (3) whether the Hebei enterprise development funds persist, and (4) whether the cash (RMB9.57/share net, 1.3x the market cap) keeps being returned as dividends. Base: revenue troughs around RMB2.1bn in FY2028-29 (two-thirds of FY2025), EBITDA settles at 28%, and the business is worth its cash plus a modest operating stub.
scenario_narratives.bull: Price resets finish in 2026, the Essential Drugs List expansion and two exclusive new drugs re-grow oral products from FY2028, consolidation lets Shineway hold formula-granule prices, and structural S&D savings keep margins at 32%.
scenario_narratives.bear: Injections are restricted by the NMPA re-evaluation, further provincial VBP alliances cut granule prices again, the subsidy is withdrawn and the business halves with 20% margins. Even so the cash floor holds: the bear value remains above the current price because the price is below net cash.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 30%: a single-regulator dependency (NHSA/NMPA policy drives every product line at once) and three consecutive periods of accelerating decline with management saying pressure 'will persist'. Bull cut to 20% because it needs two independent things to go right -- the policy reset ending in 2026 AND the 2027 drug launches succeeding -- and management gives no inflection date. Base 50%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: At the current price (inputs.price_as_of) the market capitalisation (RMB4.65bn) is 64% of net cash (RMB7.23bn) -- the operating business is priced at a negative enterprise value. The DCF therefore reads as 'cash minus withholding tax plus a shrunken TCM stub', and every scenario lands above the price; the finding is not that the stub is undervalued but that the market applies a ~40% haircut to PRC-held cash and a controlling-shareholder structure. We do not apply that haircut: the cash is in bank deposits earning ~3% (interest RMB216m on an average ~RMB6.9bn balance ties), RMB1.23/share of 2026 dividends (RMB929m, more than the trailing year's profit) are being paid out of it, and the 5% repatriation WHT is charged explicitly in the equity bridge. Risk is charged once -- in the driver paths and a 30% bear weight -- not stacked into the discount rate. SBC-zero filer: house and street bases coincide and band_position is null.
key_risks_to_valuation: Cash accessibility: ~RMB7.5bn is held in PRC subsidiaries under a 66% controlling shareholder; if distributions stopped or the cash were redeployed into low-return 'financial products' or acquisitions, the bridge value would not reach minority holders
Revenue has no visible floor yet: H1-2026 -28.5% with every product line declining; the base case assumes the trough is FY2028-29 at two-thirds of FY2025, which is a judgment, not guidance
Enterprise development funds (~RMB150-170m/yr, ~5% of revenue, ~15-20% of operating EBITDA) are discretionary Hebei policy support kept inside the margin path
Falling PRC deposit rates reduce investment income, which the model excludes from the flows but which funds the dividend in the near term
Trust-held 71.6m shares (8.7% of the 827m issued) could be awarded, cutting per-share values by 8.7%
CNY/HKD rate: a 5% CNY depreciation moves every HKD per-share value by 5%
